maddeler.e:
ننتقل (form VIII)
# نَنْتَقِلُ (nantaqilu) /nan.ta.qi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# نُنْتَقَلُ (nuntaqalu) /nun.ta.qa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# نَنْتَقِلَ (nantaqila) /nan.ta.qi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# نُنْتَقَلَ (nuntaqala) /nun.ta.qa.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
